doc_summary: `native_interact_entity_v2(entity, kind, hand, stack, cancel)`: `native_interact_entity` with the hand (`Hand::Main` or `Hand::Off`, NeoForge's `PlayerInteractEvent.EntityInteract.getHand`), asked right after v1, once per hand vanilla tries; a click v1 claimed is not asked again.
